content.text: Pegue um app (próprio ou open-source médio) e construa harness completo em 6 camadas:

data.code:
# .github/workflows/test.yml
jobs:
  unit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm vitest run --coverage

  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres: { image: postgres:16, ports: ['5432:5432'] }
      redis: { image: redis:7 }
    steps:
      - run: pnpm test:integration

  contract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: pact-broker publish pacts/
      - run: pact-provider-verifier

  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix: { shard: [1, 2, 3, 4] }
    steps:
      - run: pnpm playwright test --shard=${'$'}{{ matrix.shard }}/4

  perf-budget:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: k6 run --threshold "p95<500" scripts/smoke.js

# Job weekly (cron):
  mutation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: npx stryker run
      - run: ./check-mutation-baseline.sh

items: Unit (vitest) com cobertura > 80% em módulos críticos

data.content: Entregável: repo com CI verde, coverage badge, mutation score > 75%, relatório de perf. Isso é qualidade engineering real — não marketing.
